name: Zach Nunn
page_title: Zach Nunn's Issue Positions (Political Courage Test)
on_the_ballot: Running, Republican for U.S. House (IA) - District 3

positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "As a faith-oriented man, Zach will always stand with Iowa’s most vulnerable – that means protecting our seniors, our disabled, and our unborn. He is a recognized pro-life leader, committed to fighting for the unborn. Zach continues to advocate for Iowa’s next generations in Washington, while Democrats continue to allow abortion on demand. As a father of six, two of which he adopted earlier this year, Zach is fighting in Congress to simplify the adoption process and ensure every child finds their forever home."
Rated 100% by National Right to Life Committee
Voted in favor of HR 26: "Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act"

positions.question: Do you support expanding federal funding to support social safety net programs such as Social Security and Medicare?

evidence.text: "I am 100% committed to safeguarding Medicare and Social Security for Iowa’s retirees."
"I am 100% committed to protecting Medicare and Social Security. I’ll never back down from a fight to prevent politicians from playing games with your benefits!"

"Time and again, I hear from Iowans concerned about politicians in D.C. playing games with their Medicare coverage. I am 100% committed to protecting these benefits and just this past week voted to improve and expand healthcare support for patients on Medicare and other programs."
Rated 10% by Alliance for Retired Americans

positions.question: Do you support a decrease in income taxes in order to balance the budget?

evidence.text: "As a dad of six, I know how expensive life can get, especially as the cost of everyday goods continues to skyrocket. Last week, I helped pass massive tax relief for Iowa families - because your money is better off in your pocket than in the hands of the federal government."

"Out-of-control government spending has caused inflation to skyrocket, impacting every Iowa family’s ability to balance their checkbook. In Congress, he passed legislation to rein in government bureaucracy and the liberal wish lists impeding our economy. We must stop the tax-and-spend policies that have driven us to record cost levels and help get Americans back to work"
Rated 82% by FreedomWorks
Voted in favor of HF 2317: "Reduces the Income Tax Rate to a 4 Percent Flat Tax by 2026"

positions.question: Do you support a wealth tax in order to pay for public programs?

evidence.text: "As a dad of six, I know how expensive life can get, especially as the cost of everyday goods continues to skyrocket. Last week, I helped pass massive tax relief for Iowa families - because your money is better off in your pocket than in the hands of the federal government."

positions.question: Do you support the regulation of indirect campaign contributions from corporations, unions, and individuals?

evidence.text: Rated 0% by End Citizens United

positions.question: Do you support protecting government officials, including law enforcement officers, from personal liability in civil lawsuits concerning alleged misconduct?

evidence.text: "I was thankful to spend some time with police officers from Iowa this week to learn more about law enforcement retention and policy changes to make officer's lives a little easier as they protect us. I will always be a champion for our law enforcement. #BackTheBlue"
"Just like we’ve done in Iowa with the Back the Blue bill, today I voted in Congress to support law enforcement officers. We will not allow attacks on police officers to go unpunished."

"With crime running rampant across the country, I voted today to stop radical anti-police policies. Instead of ostracizing law enforcement trying to help our communities, we should provide essential tools and training so they can better do their jobs."

positions.question: Do you support increasing defense spending?

evidence.text: "America is the greatest nation in the world and we must continue protecting our citizens from all enemies foreign and domestic – both at home and abroad. As a 20 year combat veteran, Zach knows the importance of a strong military when it comes to defending our country, protecting democracy, and promoting peace. In Washington, he supported policies that not only adequately fund our military but prioritize our veterans, active military, military families, and mental health."
Voted in favor of HR 2670: "National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024"
Voted in favor of HR 4365: "Department of Defense Appropriations Act, 2024"

positions.question: Do you support federal spending as a means of promoting economic growth (e.g. grants, tax incentives)?

evidence.text: "#DebtCeiling Did you know every baby born today has a $94,000 share of federal debt? With national debt growing, we need to act now to prevent default and rein in spending."

"Iowans balance their checkbook and live within their means. Congress should too. I joined the House Budget Committee today to discuss my Balanced Budget Amendment that would rein in out-of-control government spending."

"Out-of-control government spending has caused inflation to skyrocket, impacting every Iowa family’s ability to balance their checkbook. In Congress, he passed legislation to rein in government bureaucracy and the liberal wish lists impeding our economy. We must stop the tax-and-spend policies that have driven us to record cost levels and help get Americans back to work"
Voted in favor of HR 2811: "Limit, Save, Grow Act"

positions.question: Do you support the federal government increasing funding for affordable housing programs?

evidence.text: "The housing crisis in rural Iowa is no joke! I’m leading the bipartisan Promote Affordable Rural Housing Act to help ensure affordable housing is available in communities across Iowa."

"The lack of affordable housing impacts families across Iowa, especially in rural communities. I’m proud to share that just last weekend, the President signed my bipartisan bill, boosting affordable housing options in rural communities, into law!"

"The lack of affordable housing is impacting all of Iowa - but especially our rural communities. That’s why I introduced bipartisan legislation to address this crisis and fight for our rural communities to ensure they have the support they need."

"We must address the affordable housing crisis - that’s exactly why I introduced commonsense, bipartisan legislation to help nonprofits and local governments address the shortage of affordable housing in their communities."

positions.question: Do you support the federal government taking action, beyond those of the Federal Reserve, to alleviate inflation?

evidence.text: "Inflation has negative impacts on every family and small business. That’s why I voted today to rein in inflationary federal policies and give relief to all Americans."

"Inflation is costing Iowans more, and this Thanksgiving is no different — another example of why it’s so important for us to rein in out-of-control government spending that is driving up costs for everyone!"
"Out-of-control spending by the federal government is causing inflation to skyrocket. In Congress, I’m fighting to make life easier for Iowa families."

"Service should always come before self, and that’s why I’m introducing a bill to end automatic pay raises for Members of Congress. While Iowans pinch pennies because of inflation, representatives should not be getting an extra $3+ million in pay raises."

positions.question: Do you support the forgiveness of federal student loan debt?

evidence.text: Rated 25% by National Education Association

positions.question: Do you support requiring a government-issued identification in order to vote at the polls?

positions.question: Do you support government funding for the development of renewable energy (e.g. solar, wind, geo-thermal)?

evidence.text: "IA is the #1 producer of renewable fuels - we are paving the way to ensure affordable, sustainable, and independent sources of energy. Great to meet with IA Renewable Fuels Association to discuss creating jobs, lowering the cost of gas, and protecting our environment!"

"Iowa’s energy industry is working to make America energy independent again. Iowa’s renewable fuels, ethanol, biodiesel, wind, solar, and more prove our country can have a diversified and strong energy portfolio. #NationalRenewableEnergyDay"
"Renewable fuels drive down energy costs and help make America energy independent. I am committed to supporting policies that lower energy costs for Iowa families. #RenewableEnergyDay"

"The hands, hearts, and hard work of Iowa farmers feed and fuel our country. Zach fights in DC for a Farm Bill to ensure Iowa’s farmers and rural communities have support they need to continue to drive Iowa’s economy. Also a tireless advocate for Iowa’s biofuels and ethanol producers, he pushed for strong support for renewable fuels that help make America more energy independent. He’ll continue to be a voice at the table for Iowa’s rural communities, ensuring their voice drives decisions – not Washington bureaucrats."

positions.question: Do you support the federal government allowing permits for drilling on public lands?

evidence.text: "We can never underestimate the value of American energy independence. We passed the Lower Energy Costs Act so every American has access to safe, reliable, and affordable energy. We must end reliance on foreign governments."
"Yesterday I voted to reverse this Administration’s ban on energy exports, increase the energy security of the U.S. and our allies, and protect American jobs."
Voted in favor of HR 1: "Lower Energy Costs Act"
Voted in favor of HR 21: "Strategic Production Response Act"

positions.question: Do you generally support gun-control legislation (e.g. red flag laws, boyfriend loopholes)?

evidence.text: "Zach put his life on the line to protect our First and Second Amendment Rights – he’s a firm believer in the right to free speech and the right to bear arms."
Rated 100% by Gun Owners of America
Rated 92% by National Rifle Association

positions.question: Do you support a government-run (e.g. single-payer) healthcare program, such as Medicare-for-All?

evidence.text: "Access to healthcare is critical throughout Iowa. I’m fighting to improve opportunities for community health centers and telehealth so that everyone has the access they need - no matter where they live!"

"I just voted to protect Medicare benefits for Iowans. No D.C. bureaucrats should be picking winners and losers in our healthcare system - and this legislation protects those with chronic diseases or disabilities from being left behind."
"I’m committed to working in bipartisan fashion to improve healthcare for all Iowans."

positions.question: Do you support expanding paid family AND/OR medical leave benefits (e.g. maternity leave)?

evidence.text: "As a father of six, Zach is familiar with the struggles too many Iowa families face. He is fighting to make it easier for parents to work, raise families, and pay the bills. His first bill that passed the House of Representatives expanded parental leave for military parents, ensuring those who serve our country have time with new children. He’s also led the charge to simplify adoption, expand child care options, and support working parents."

"I led the bipartisan Parental Leave Parity Act to expand parental leave to drilling Reservists and National Guard members, and this week, our bill passed the House. We continue to make progress on our mission to bring more Iowa commonsense to Washington, D.C.!"

"ICYMI: With the passage of my bipartisan bill, we’re expanding parental leave for parents in the National Guard and Reserve. If you’re willing to serve our country, you should be able to spend time with new children."

positions.question: Should the government be able to regulate the cost of prescription drugs?

evidence.text: "Iowa families are struggling to afford necessary health care due to out-of-control prescription drug prices, which is why I’m working with @RepSpanberger to create transparency for patients, families, and providers."
Voted in favor of HR 5378: "Lower Costs, More Transparency Act"

positions.question: Do you support increasing security along the southern US border?

evidence.text: "Iowa is a special place and we need to keep it that way. As your voice in Washington, Zach is fighting to keep our families and neighborhoods safe by supporting our heroes in law enforcement and first responders who serve our communities. As your representative, he helped pass the most comprehensive border security solution – ensuring that we’re combatting the flow of illegal drugs, human trafficking, and exploitation coming across our Southern Border."
Rated 90% by NumbersUSA
Voted in favor of HR 2: "Secure the Border Act of 2023"
Voted in favor of HR 5525: "Continuing Appropriations and Border Security Enhancement Act, 2024"

positions.question: Do you support requiring immigrants to return to their country of origin before they are eligible for citizenship, regardless of their immigration status?

evidence.text: "Clearly, there is a crisis at our Southern Border - we’ve seen more than 8 million illegal crossings in the past 3 years alone! Today, we passed legislation to get accountability for this crisis and support border security."

"December saw an all-time high number of illegal crossings at our Southern Border. Failed policies have gotten us here. We must get control of our border to stop the flow of illegal drugs into our country!"
Rated 90% by NumbersUSA

positions.question: Do you support the US providing increased offensive military aid to Ukraine?

evidence.text: "Russia must be stopped, but American taxpayers are not Ukraine’s piggy bank. I’m introducing new legislation to use seized Russian assets - instead of American taxpayer dollars - to force Russia to pay for their war on Ukraine."

"Sending Ukraine defensive weapons (SAM patriot batteries) a year ago would have saved thousands of lives. The sending of 31 U.S. tanks will not change the outcome, but will cost taxpayers even more. America needs a strategy to support our allies, not a blank checkbook."
Voted against HR 5692: "Ukraine Security Assistance and Oversight Supplemental Appropriations Act, 2024"
Voted in favor of HR 8035: "Ukraine Security Supplemental Appropriations Act, 2024"

positions.question: Do you generally support increased regulations on social media companies (e.g. Tik Tok, Facebook, etc.)?

evidence.text: "Across the country, cartels are using TikTok, Snapchat, Instagram, and more to infiltrate high schools. I’m co-leading legislation to protect our kids and stop the cartels’ influence."

"Right now, our country is under attack from the radical efforts of the far left and Big Tech who are muzzling our constitutional rights. In Washington, he’s putting a stop to any DC politicians who try to tell us how to act or how to defend our families."
Voted in favor of HR 7521: "Protecting Americans from Foreign Adversary Controlled Applications Act"
